title: Normalized baseline run result
description: One record per (baseline, case, attempt-budget) — the ONLY shape that comes back out of baselines/vendor/. Every baseline's native output is normalized into this so results/ is directly comparable to our own runs and to the paper_reported/ tables. Deliberately mirrors the fields our own run artifacts already carry (verdict, cost_usd, agent_duration_ms) so one join key works across both.

baseline.description: Key from pins.json, or "p2patch" for one of our own runs re-expressed in this schema.

baseline_commit.description: Commit actually run (must match pins.json unless explicitly overridden).

case_id.description: Canonical case id — our cve_id (e.g. CVE-2016-5321, gnubug-19784, bugzilla-2611). Join key across everything.

batch.description: Free-form batch label, e.g. "b1-gpt4o", matching how our runs carry `label`.

model.description: LLM actually used. Required for any published number — model era is a confound.

budget.description: Attempt budget, so a matched-budget comparison is reconstructable.

outcome.description: The headline, in PatchAgent/San2Patch terms. `plausible` = compiled AND PoC blocked but functional tests not run or not available; `repaired` additionally passed functional tests. `errored` is infrastructure, NOT a failed repair — it must be excluded from denominators, not counted as a loss (same errored-vs-rejected split our own pipeline uses).

inapplicable_reason.description: Required when outcome == inapplicable. E.g. "no sanitizer-observable fault" for a Java XSS case fed to a sanitizer-driven tool. Applicability is a result, not a gap in the data.

gates.description: The individual gates behind `outcome`. null = not run (distinct from false = ran and failed).

our_scores.description: OUR evaluation applied to THEIR patch — the part no baseline paper reports about itself. Scored by replaying fix_povs/ and residual_povs/ against the baseline's patch with the same harness our runs use.

fix_pov_score.description: blocked/(blocked+reproduced) over certified fixPOVs; null if none certified for this case.

residual_score.description: Bonus metric: fraction of holes the official fix left open that this patch closed. 0 is a fine result.

judge_score.description: Blind LLM patch-quality score, 0-100, same rubric and arm-anonymisation as PIPELINE_ANALYSIS_v4.

patch.description: Pointer to the produced patch. The diff itself lives beside this record as patches/<case_id>.diff so results/ stays greppable.

raw_log_path.description: Path under baselines/work/ (gitignored). Kept for debugging; not published.
